title_en: GN Fan Fest Is Back for Fall 2026 With 90 Exclusive Reveals, Including Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, Where Winds Meet, and More
summary_en: IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition returns October 14 with 90 exclusive reveals. Here is how to watch and the full lineup, including VisionQuest, Where Winds Meet, and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.
body_en:
IGN Fan Fest is back with 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. Tune in Wednesday, October 14 to see game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more.
Streaming across all IGN platforms, IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition will see the reveal of more than 10 brand-new games plus tons of first-looks, news, and giveaways from the biggest titles and games in entertainment.
Fans can expect brand-new reveals from major movies like Whalefall and Ebenezer , exclusives from shows like VisionQuest , Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, and The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon , and looks at major new games like Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege , Where Winds Meet , War Hammer 40,000, and more.
We'll also have a slew of celebrity appearances including Austin Abrams , Josh Brolin , Paul Bettany , Liam McIntyre , James Spader , and more.
But that’s not all. Starting on Monday, October 12, head over to IGN.com for even more announcements, deep dives, and game reveals. We’ll be spending the whole week bringing you the never-before-seen details of the biggest and best titles of the Fall.
It all leads up to the main event: the IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition livestream October 14 at 10am PDT / 1pm EDT / 6pm BST. You can catch the show on IGN.com, YouTube, Steam, Facebook, Twitch, and X.
While we can’t reveal everything that’s part of the show just yet, we can announce the following titles that will have major reveals during the event:
9 Yin Sutra: Immortal
Acornia: Mirror Worlds
Acts of Blood
Anno 117: Pax Romana
Arizona Sunshine
Checkmate Protocol
For The Stars
Golden Retriever Simple Life
Over the Hill
Silk & Sorrow
Sker: The Bleeding Veil
Splizards
The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
The Forge: Steel Frontier
The Lich Wars
There are No Ghosts at the Grand
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
UvsU: You vs You
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
Where Winds Meet
Crawlers
Ebenezer
Whalefall
Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
Bass X Machina
Blue Eye Samurai Season 2
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
Golden Axe
IDW Publishing feat. GODZILLA & SONIC THE HEDGEHOG
Mayfair Witches
The Boulet Brothers' Dragula
The Walking Dead Daryl Dixon
VisionQuest
Everything kicks off October 12, 2026 everywhere you get IGN.
Last year’s IGN Fan Fest: Fall Edition saw a huge week of reveals including first-looks at movies like Predator: Badlands, Frankenstein, and Good Fortune, shows including The Witcher, Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell: Deathwatch, and The Mighty Nein, and games like Dispatch, Terminator 2D: No Fate, and The Outer Worlds 2.
Stay tuned to IGN in the coming weeks as we reveal more about October’s jam–packed show.
